name: Abrol, the Elf-Drinker
desc: This broadsword of Inferior Bronze appears worn and tarnished when first found, and has the expected +0 OB bonus. However, once it slays an Elf, the corrosion will drop away and the blade gleam as if newly forged. If it should go a year without slaying an Elf, the tarnished look will return. When it slays an Elf, it feeds off the soul, and for each level of the slain Elf, the wielder may heal a concussion hit, a -1 of breakage penalty may be removed from the blade, or the wielder may recover 1 PP. Furthermore, for every level of the Elf slain, Abrol gains +1 to its OB, up to a maximum of +25. This bonus fades at a loss of +1 for each day that passes since Abrol has killed an Elf. A rare combination of extreme serendipity (extra OB when serial-killing Elves) and a flaw (it only feeds on Elvish souls), Abrol is notorious among Elves and celebrated by their enemies. Either might pay more than it is worth in order to wield or destroy this unique weapon.

name: Access Book
desc: This appears as a slender, portable religious text, and it is. (Minimum value: 2 sp.) However, it is also a method of gaining a knowledge of passwords, countersigns, and the like. Any approach within 100' of a guard or checkpoint will trigger a Commune True (Communal Ways) which will cause the password (or similar information) for the guard/ checkpoint to appear on a certain page. The word or phrase thus written will disappear once read.

name: Adamantine Helm
desc: A heavy helm of adamant steel (3015sp) set with rubies (500sp), this beautiful head protection negates 75% of all head criticals, while having no maneuver or perception penalty. It is “indestructible” and fits any Medium head.

name: Adamantine Shield
desc: This is a full shield of adamant steel (+25 Shield skill, base price of 3,007sp), with the Autofocusing, Mobility, Resilience, and Weapon Bane abilities (see the Armor Enchantment list).

name: Air Drake Armor
desc: This is a full set of armor created from the hide of an old air drake (AT 8, 460sp). In addition to the advantages of dragonskin armor, it provides various magical abilities. The wearer can cast Fly III (Lofty Bridge) in combination with Extension IV (Spell Enhancement) once a day (duration 44 minutes). Twice per day, the wearer can cast Lightning Bolt I (Light Law). Finally, the armor provides a constant Lightarmor (Elemental Shields).

name: Akarak, Slayer of Fire Spirits
enchant: Slaying I (15) x 2 for elemental bolt x 3 for creature Type x 1/2 for subgroup
desc: This oak rod casts Water Bolt I (Water Law) with the bolts enchanted to be Slaying I against fire elementals.

name: Amulet of Arnd
desc: This simple silver necklace with a shield-shaped pendant (80 sp value) provides a constant Blur (Shield Mastery) effect on the wearer.

name: Amulet of Beastform (Dangerous)
desc: An Amulet of Beastform is a silver figurine of an animal, usually kept on a silver chain and worn as a necklace (200 sp). The wearer can transform at will into the depicted animal, though his possessions (other than the necklace) will not transform. These are not the work of any mortal alchemy, being gifts from the beast-gods to their mortal servants long ago.

name: Amulet of Beastform (Non-Dangerous)
desc: An Amulet of Beastform is a silver figurine of an animal, usually kept on a silver chain and worn as a necklace (200 sp). The wearer can transform at will into the depicted animal, though his possessions (other than the necklace) will not transform. These are not the work of any mortal alchemy, being gifts from the beast-gods to their mortal servants long ago.

name: Amulet of Warding
enchant: Casting Focus III (11) x 1/10 for single list x 2 wearable
desc: This silver religious symbol on a silver chain (95 sp) allows casting Repel Undead IX (Repulsions) at will and provides a +15 bonus to SCRs when casting spells from the Repulsions list.

name: Anvil of Forging
enchant: Spell Adder III (14) x 1/2 single profession x 2 hands free
desc: This anvil provides significant benefits when incorporated into a metalcrafting workshop. It will provide up to 10 levels of spells per day from the Inorganic Skills list and is a +3 Spell Adder for Adapts.

name: Armor of Golspre (Set) - Greaves
desc: This beautifully ornate High Steel plate armor (AT 10) with inlaid gold designs. The greaves provide constant Underwater Movement (Movement Mastery). Penalty eliminated.

name: Armor of Golspre (Set) - Helmet
desc: This beautifully ornate High Steel plate armor (AT 10) with inlaid gold designs. The helmet provides constant Watervision (Physical Enhancement). Penalties eliminated.

name: Armor of Golspre (Set) - Torso
desc: This beautifully ornate High Steel plate armor (AT 10) with inlaid gold designs. Maneuver penalty reduced to -35.

name: Armor of Golspre (Set) - Vambraces
desc: This beautifully ornate High Steel plate armor (AT 10) with inlaid gold designs. The vambraces provide Waterlungs (Physical Enhancement) that trigger whenever the wearer’s head is underwater and cancels when above water. Penalties reduced to -5 maneuvers and -20 missiles.

name: Armor of Rangers (Set) - Greaves
desc: The maneuver penalty of the greaves has been reduced to -5.

name: Armor of Rangers (Set) - Torso
desc: In addition to the +15 defensive bonus the body armor provides a +10 bonus to Stalking maneuvers and Survival maneuvers.

name: Armor of Rangers (Set) - Vambraces
desc: The vambraces have been enchanted to reduce the missile penalty to -10.

name: Armor of Slickness
desc: This rigid leather armor (AT 6) is a complete set except for helmet. At need, it becomes slippery, adding +15 to Contortion maneuvers and reducing Grappling attacks by two Sizes. It also provides +10 to DB. It fits any Medium humanoid.

name: Armor-Slaying Sword
desc: This +10 claymore is made of Low Steel with a plain leather grip. The blade is inscribed “Let metal eat metal”. It has the Armor Breaker and Shield Breaker abilities.

name: Assassin Slayer
desc: This high steel (+10) arming sword is Slaying III against Magents and Slaying II against Thieves. It provides a +20 bonus to Reverse Strike skill.

name: Axe of Foul Summons
desc: This +10 long axe has a head of High Steel etched with the design of a summoning circle. The oaken haft of this weapon is stained with irregular dark blotches. Once per day, the wielder may cast Summon Demon IV, with a 90% chance that Control Demon V will be cast at the same time.

name: Axe of Orc Slaying
desc: Made from Dwarven High Steel and stout hickory, this battle axe has a +15 bonus except against Orcs. Against Orcs it is +25 and Slaying I. Dwarven High Steel improves the strength of the weapon (for breakage purposes) to 95, increased by the level of the enchantment to 110.

name: Bands of Tumbling
enchant: General II (10) x 4 for skill category
desc: This pair of bright cloth armbands add +10 to all Gymnastic maneuvers when worn and allow the wearer to cast Landing (Lofty Bridge) once a day.

name: Beamguard’s Staff
desc: This hickory (+10) quarterstaff allows its wielder to cast Fire Ball (Fire Law) once per week, spellmastered to exclude the wielder from the area of effect, allowing it to be used at close range. It also provides a +20 Grace bonus for both the Fire Law and Luminous Elements lists.

name: Bell of Awe-Inspiring
desc: This hand bell of silver (15 sp) is decorated with small, but elegant scenes of gods and goddesses performing acts of creation. The first time each day which this bell is rung, the ringer is provided with a True Aura (Light’s Way list) and this is backed up with an hour (equal in duration to the True Aura) of producing a mood of awe (±20 effect), as described in the Mood Impressions list, in all others within 20' of the bearer.

name: Bell of Healing
desc: This small golden bell with a handle in the form of a rearing unicorn (80 sp) is a +3 Spell Adder for healing spells only. When rung, it creates a peaceful mood (±10 effect) in a 20' radius. Work Precious Metals (6), Consecration (2), Infuse Mood II (11), Conditional Mood (4), Projected Mood IV (16), Sacred Adder III (11). Days: 50. Standard cost: 1,030sp. Level 16 item.

name: Bell of Stunning
desc: This is a silver bell (20 sp) decorated with spiral designs. Up to five times each day, the wielder of this bell may cast Stunning Song (Controlling Songs), playing the bell as his performance.

name: Blade of Crevice-fighting
desc: This high steel (+10) epee has a grip of blue cloth. In confined spaces, it will vary its length in response to the wielder’s desires, granting a +30 bonus to Restricted Quarters skill with this weapon.

name: Blade of Flame (Greater)
desc: This blade is of Low Steel, with a grip made from the skin of a desert snake. It comes in two versions: the Lesser and the Greater Blade of Flame. The Lesser Blade is a +10 weapon that does an extra Heat crit of one less severity than the normal critical and casts Fire Bolt I once a day. The Greater Blade is a +15 weapon doing an extra Heat crit equal in severity to the normal critical and casting Fire Ball once per day. Both have flames running along the blade when drawn. Any sword type may be found with this enchantment, and the listed price (based on a 10sp weapon) is appropriate for a broadsword, scimitar, or falchion.

name: Blade of Flame (Lesser)
desc: This blade is of Low Steel, with a grip made from the skin of a desert snake. It comes in two versions: the Lesser and the Greater Blade of Flame. The Lesser Blade is a +10 weapon that does an extra Heat crit of one less severity than the normal critical and casts Fire Bolt I once a day. The Greater Blade is a +15 weapon doing an extra Heat crit equal in severity to the normal critical and casting Fire Ball once per day. Both have flames running along the blade when drawn. Any sword type may be found with this enchantment, and the listed price (based on a 10sp weapon) is appropriate for a broadsword, scimitar, or falchion.

name: Blade of Frost (Greater)
desc: This blade is of Low Steel, with a grip made of furry snow hare hide. It comes in two versions: the Lesser and the Greater Blade of Frost. The Lesser Blade is a +10 weapon that does an extra Cold crit of one less severity than the normal critical and casts Ice Bolt I once a day. The Greater Blade is a +15 weapon doing an extra Cold crit equal in severity to the normal critical and casting Cold Ball II once per day. Both have frost spreading across the blade when drawn. Any sword type may be found with this enchantment, and the listed price (based on a 10sp weapon) is appropriate for a broadsword, scimitar, or falchion.

name: Blade of Frost (Lesser)
desc: This blade is of Low Steel, with a grip made of furry snow hare hide. It comes in two versions: the Lesser and the Greater Blade of Frost. The Lesser Blade is a +10 weapon that does an extra Cold crit of one less severity than the normal critical and casts Ice Bolt I once a day. The Greater Blade is a +15 weapon doing an extra Cold crit equal in severity to the normal critical and casting Cold Ball II once per day. Both have frost spreading across the blade when drawn. Any sword type may be found with this enchantment, and the listed price (based on a 10sp weapon) is appropriate for a broadsword, scimitar, or falchion.

name: Blade of Warning
desc: These high steel (+10) blades have an extra +5 OB against any creature of darkness and an extra +10 OB against orcs and trolls (these bonuses are cumulative with the base +10 but not with each other). The blade will glow when “evil” is within 100'. This enchantment is normally found on an arming sword, a broadsword, a dagger, a falchion, a longsword, or a short sword. The listed price is for a broadsword, scimitar, or falchion.

name: Blanket of Warming
desc: This blanket has a constant Rain Deflection (Weather Ways) and a constant Resist Cold (Elemental Shields) effect, assuring a warm, dry place of rest for the user.

name: Bonebane
enchant: Constant X (40) x 2 for triggered effect
desc: This iron-headed mace is a +10 weapon, but the power for which it is named is the delivery of a Break Limb (Flesh Destruction list) spell with every critical inflicted.

name: Boots of Agility
desc: These bright green boots with silver ornaments (8 sp) add +2 to the wearer’s Agility stat bonus.

name: Boots of Escape
desc: These boots are commonly found in Small or Medium size, and will fit any humanoid of the correct Size. The wearer can cast a combined Dash and Spider’s Walk (Movement Mastery) once each day.

name: Boots of Landing
desc: The wearer of these green leather boots takes no damage from falls of up to 40' and reduces the effective height of falls from greater heights by 40'. They fit any feet of the right Size and have been found in Small, Medium, and Big. Automatic Sizing Organic (6), Work Mundane Leather (3), Landing (2, Lofty Bridge), Embed II (5), Constant III (17). Days: 33. Standard cost: 627sp. Level 17 item.

name: Boots of Leaping
desc: The wearer of these red leather boots may make a vertical leap of 20' or a lateral leap of 50' each round. They fit any feet of the right Size and have been found in Small, Medium, and Big. Automatic Sizing Organic (6), Work Mundane Leather (3), Leaping (1, Lofty Bridge), Embed I (3), Constant III (17). Days: 30. Standard cost: 570sp. Level 17 item.

name: Boots of Light Feet
desc: These blue leather boots fit any humanoid feet of the right Size (and they have been found in Small, Medium, and Big), allow the wearer to use Leaping or Landing (Lofty Bridge list) once each round, prevent foot odor, provide a +50 RR bonus against fungal or parasitic attacks on the feet. If worn while recovering from a foot or ankle injury, they halve the recovery time.

name: Boots of Silence
desc: These dark brown leather boots add +20 to the wearer’s Stalking maneuvers and allow the casting of Sphere of Silence I (Sound Molding) thrice a day. They fit any Medium humanoid feet.

name: Boots of Speed
desc: These boots allow the wearer to cast up to 20 PP per day of spells from the Rapid Ways list up to 7th level. They will fit any humanoid feet of the right Size (and they have been found in Small, Medium, and Large).

name: Boots of Wind Walking
desc: These fine (3 sp) boots of blue leather and brass provide Wind Drift (Movement) twice per day.

name: Boots of Yark
desc: These Medium-sized brown leather boots fit any wearer. In addition to all the powers of Boots of Light Feet, these boots also provide a constant Sprint spell (Movement Mastery list) and allow the casting of Fly II (Lofty Bridge) once per day.

name: Bracers of Gorgax
enchant: Spell Adder II (9) x 1/2 for single profession x 2 for wearable
desc: These rigid leather (medium) vambraces are a +2 spell adder for Clerics and provide a +10 bonus to SCRs when casting spells from the Repulsions list.

name: Breastplate of Channeling
desc: This body armor (AT 10) of high steel has been enchanted to provide a +15 DB, and it further provides a +15 bonus to both the Channeling and Transcendence skills.

name: Breastplate of Thonian
desc: This +10 superior bronze breastplate is decorated with symbols of law and order. It negates fully 50% of torso criticals inflicted on the wearer. It also allows its wearer to cast Fly II (Lofty Bridge) and Reverse Spell I (Spell Reins) each once per day, at a 60th level of effect. It fits any Medium humanoid.

name: Capacious Storage (Greater)
desc: A common category of item, these backpacks and boxes are enchanted to hold more than they appear, reduce the weight of their contents, protect those contents from harm, and permit the possessor to immediately find whatever contents they are looking for.

name: Capacious Storage (Lesser)
desc: A common category of item, these backpacks and boxes are enchanted to hold more than they appear, reduce the weight of their contents, protect those contents from harm, and permit the possessor to immediately find whatever contents they are looking for.

name: Capacious Storage (Minor)
desc: A common category of item, these backpacks and boxes are enchanted to hold more than they appear, reduce the weight of their contents, protect those contents from harm, and permit the possessor to immediately find whatever contents they are looking for.

name: Capacious Storage (Moderate)
desc: A common category of item, these backpacks and boxes are enchanted to hold more than they appear, reduce the weight of their contents, protect those contents from harm, and permit the possessor to immediately find whatever contents they are looking for.

name: Cape of the Black Hand
desc: This stylish dark grey cloak (1 sp) bears a life-sized silhouette of a right hand in black in the lower right corner. Once per day, the wearer may cast Darkness I (from Light Law) linked with Darkvision (from Physical Enhancement). This provides two hours of a 10' radius magical darkness around the wearer, through which he can see (as well as seeing through any other darkness to 10').

name: Caprayi, the Eternal Wind
desc: This white longbow is constructed of polished springwood with fittings of gold and adamantese (the bow would be worth 1000 sp even unenchanted). Utterly beautiful to behold, it is equally deadly. It has range increments increased by +50’ and arrows fired from it strike with a +1 Size increase and do an additional Impact critical of equal severity. Against Large or larger creatures, it is also a Slaying II weapon. This was originally the weapon of the God of the East Wind, but he gave it to a mortal champion and it passed out of mythology and into history. The Slaying power of this weapon is broader than allowed by mortal enchantments, but it has a limitation to creatures of great size, which are rarer, but more powerful. A multiplier of x10 is therefore used.

name: Channeling Shield
desc: This normal shield is of oak, bound with Low Steel (46sp) and enchanted to +10 Shield skill. It gives its bearer a +15 bonus to the Channeling skill.

name: Choker of Azrak
enchant: Power Multiplier VI (75) x 3 universal x 2 wearable
desc: This bejeweled gold choker has a jewelry value of 300 sp. It is “indestructible”, negates 50% of head criticals, and is a universal x3 PP Multiplier.

name: Choker of Whispers
enchant: Spell Adder II (9) x 1/2 for single profession x 2 for wearable
desc: This is a coral bead choker set with a large topaz (value: 310 sp). Both coral and stone are pink. It is a +2 Spell Adder for Bards, and it allows the use of Long Whisper I (Sound Projection) five times per day.

name: Circlet of Mentalism
desc: This silver circlet (60 sp) is worn on the head, where it protects as a light helm and serves as a x1.25 PP Multiplier for Mentalism. It provides a +10 bonus to RRs against Mentalism as well.

name: Claw Hand Gloves
desc: Commonly found in Small or Medium sizes, these gloves (15 sp base value) have long been favored by scouts, bandits, assassins, and spies who wish to make their kills look like animal attacks. They may be used as Unarmed: Strikes weapons, or they may be used to make an Unarmed: Claw attack (at the wearer’s Size). In either case, they grant +10 OB and an additional Slash critical one severity less than the primary critical.

name: Climber’s Gloves
desc: These fine leather gloves fit securely and have an exceptional grip, granting +10 to all Climbing maneuvers.

name: Cloak of Cloaking
desc: This cloak allows the wearer to cast Cloaking I twice per day and gives a +15 Stalking bonus.

name: Cloak of Darkness
enchant: Spell Adder III (14) x 3 universal x 1/3 Evil
desc: This is a x1.5 PP Multiplier and a +3 Spell Adder for Evil spellcasters. It adds 10 ranks (does not increase skill bonus) to Running (which improves passive dodging). If anyone not an Evil spellcaster puts on the cloak, this triggers a Demonic Possession II (Mind Domination) spell, cast on the wearer.

name: Cloak of Stealth
desc: The wearer of this cloak gains a +20 bonus to Stalking skill.

name: Collar of Animal Speech
desc: This adjustable collar will fit any animal of a given Size (roll randomly on 1d100: 1-5, Diminutive; 6-25, Tiny; 26-60, Small; 61-80, Medium; 81-90, Big; 91-97, Large; 98-00, Huge). The animal wearing the collar will be able to speak and understand the native language of a person attuned to the collar. This does not otherwise change the intelligence or personality of the animal. These items are produced by a sect of Sanctifiers that worship animal spirits and learn a variant Divine Touch list where Sacred Script is replaced with a spell that produces this effect, called Animal Speech. The collars are decorative, with a minimum cost of 10 sp.

name: Collar of Unpain
desc: A collar of eog (450 sp) that can be worn with any armor, this device will negate 30% of criticals to the head. Additionally, the wearer can cast Unpain II (Body Reins) once per day.

name: Crossbow Wand
desc: Misnamed by explorers who first encountered them, the name stuck as these magical blowpipes were exported. They have an increased range (+25' range increment), and their darts strike as if a Size larger. They have been produced for both Small and Medium users.

name: Crowga’s Quarterstaff
desc: This oak (+5) quarterstaff will cast a spell on any target it strikes when wielded by a Sorcerer. If the crit is on a limb, a Break Limb (Flesh Destruction) spell is cast, otherwise a Touch of Disruption (Flesh Destruction) is cast.

name: Crushing Shield
desc: This full shield of superior bronze (with leather grip and straps) bears the image of a clenched fist. It has a +10 Shield skill bonus, and when used for a shield bash, the Size of the shield bash attack is increased by one.

name: Crystal Knife
desc: This unique dagger has a blade made of a slender rock crystal that glistens with rainbow colors, but has the strength of steel (+10 Strength for breakage checks). The gripping end is wrapped in elephant leather as a simple handle. It is a +10 weapon and a +3 Spell Adder for non-Evil Channeling. It provides a +20 bonus to DB against Directed Spells. It is said to be a gift from a god of earth and stone, made from one of his own teeth. Because of its unique nature and attractive blade, this item is estimated at 200 sp unenchanted. Work Stone (10), Consecration (2), Spell Adder III (14), Sacred Protections IV (14), Sacred Weapon II (7). Days: 47. Standard cost: 999sp. Level 14 item.

name: Dagger of Assassination
desc: This iron dagger has a pommel in the shape of a skull and the grip is wrapped in black linen. The metal itself has been stained black, almost eliminating the gleam of the metal. When this +10 weapon is drawn, its wielder gains a +10 bonus to Stalking, a +10 bonus to Ambush: Melee Weapons, and most notably, an extra 10 ranks of Ambush: Melee Weapons.

name: Darkling Leather
desc: Intended to be the ultimate stealth armor, this leather jerkin (AT 6) grants a +30 bonus to Stalking, but due to a spell failure, this bonus only applies if the wearer is already getting a bonus to his maneuver due to poor lighting.

name: Darts of Staying
desc: These darts have a single-use enchantment. Upon first delivering a critical, one of these darts will also deliver a Hold True (Spirit Mastery) spell to the target.

name: Daywalking Cloak
desc: Usually a simple black, brown, or gray hooded cloak, these items are used by many important members of the sun-sensitive Races. It provides constant protection as the Resist Light spell (Elemental Shields list). They may be found in various Sizes, to fit the various Races that need such protection.

name: Death Crown
enchant: Spell Adder VII (40) x 1/10 for single list x 2 wearable
Spell Adder VII (40) x 1/10 for single list x 2 wearable
desc: This is a crown of bright silver with black gems, which would be worth 1000 sp as jewelry alone. It is a x2 Essence PP Multiplier, as well as acting as a +7 Spell Adder for the Necromancy Mastery list and as a +7 Spell Adder for the Necromantic Ways list. Furthermore, the (attuned) wearer may cast Army of the Dead True once per month.

name: Delving Text of Yol
desc: This large book (5 sp) serves as a magical reference on items. It allows casting each of the following spells once per week: Armor Analysis (Armor Enchantment), Fluid Analysis (Fluid Skills), Item Analysis (General Enchantment), Metal Analysis (Inorganic Skills), Stone Analysis (Inorganic Skills), Machine Analysis (Mechanical Mastery), Weapon Analysis (Weapon Enchantment).

name: Demonslayer
desc: This high steel arming sword is enchanted to +20, with an additional +15 against all beings of darkness. It is a Holy Weapon, and against Extra Planar Creatures it is Slaying II and does an additional Cold critical of equal severity to the normal critical. Holy Weapons strike as if one Size larger when used against Evil entities, do an additional Holy critical two severities less than the regular critical, inflict a B Holy critical of the creature’s size on Evil creatures directly touching them, and are Slaying I against demons and undead of a larger size than the wielder (this is cumulative with this weapon’s Slaying II effect against extra-planar creatures if both apply).

name: Dermik Dral’s Omba
desc: This curious throwing weapon is shaped like a cross, combining four hand axe blades at a total weight of 3 pounds (Str 80, 20 sp). This has been enchanted to a +20 OB and it strikes on the battle axe table at +1 Size. It possesses a 20' range increment as a thrown weapon, and is unsuitable for melee (treat as an Exotic weapon with poor design canceling out the magic OB bonus to +0 and a fumble number of 15 if someone insists on trying).

name: Dervish Drum
enchant: Power Multiplier II (12) x 1/2 single profession
desc: This small drum uses mastodon hide and ivory in its construction, as well as wood. It is painted with the symbols of a long-lost culture. (Value is 45 sp without considering historical significance.) It is a +25 instrument and a x 1.5 PP Multiplier for Monks. The attuned user can play the drum to produce a Dancing Song (Controlling Songs) up to three times each day.

name: Desert Suit
desc: These desert robes have been enchanted to provide a constant Hues (Nature’s Guises) effect. Unfortunately, this effect only works when in a desert environment, so its value will drop considerably outside of such areas.

name: Dog-ring
desc: This is a silver ring which will fit any Small or Medium finger. Crushed sapphires appear in the design of four paw-prints (ring value: 175 sp). The wearer gains a +20 bonus to Animal Handling: Canines, as well as the sensory gifts of a dog (the talents Hearing: Dog, Acute Smell V, and Prodigy: Tracking +15).

name: Dragonskin Armor, AT 5 (+10 DB)
desc: This is a full armor suit for a Medium wearer made from some suitable draconian being’s hide and enchanted to provide a +10 bonus to the wearer’s DB, in addition to the normal benefits of the material from which it is made. Treasure Law Section 3.2: It is a tough material and quite beautiful. Perhaps the most valued quality of dragon scale armor is that being so inherently magical, it does not interfere with spellcasting. Of course, it does not provide an RR bonus against spells, either. Dragon scale armors weigh 80% of what an armor of its type normally would and are comfortable in a range of temperatures. Treat the wearer of a full suit of dragon scale as being in conditions 20 degrees Fahrenheit (or 10 degrees Celsius) closer to ideal temperature than they really are. Provide half that modification if someone is wearing less than a full suit, but at least has his torso covered in dragon scale.

desc: This is a full armor suit for a Medium wearer made from some suitable draconian being’s hide and enchanted to provide a +15 bonus to the wearer’s DB, in addition to the normal benefits of the material from which it is made.
